class.name: NetwSimulationHandle
class.brief_description: Where and how one [NetwEntity]'s body runs on each peer.

method.name: forget
method.description: Withdraws the selection [method simulate] made for [param entity]. The automatic policy may still select it.

method.name: simulate
method.description: Always selects [param entity], so it runs here as [constant MODE_ACTIVE] while this entity runs here as [constant MODE_AUTHORITY] or [constant MODE_PREDICT]. An entity in another scene is refused with an error and is not selected.

method.name: simulate_all
method.description: Selects every entity this peer holds in [param layer]. An empty [param layer] reads this entity's own [NetwInterestLayer] membership.

method.name: simulate_nearest
method.description: Selects the [param count] entities nearest this one among those this peer holds in [param layer]. An empty [param layer] reads this entity's own [NetwInterestLayer] membership. A negative [param count] selects nothing.

method.name: simulate_none
method.description: Drops the automatic policy. Entities named with [method simulate] stay selected.

method.name: simulate_within
method.description: Selects the entities within [param meters] of this one among those this peer holds in [param layer]. A selected entity leaves only once it is 10% past [param meters]. A negative [param meters] selects nothing.

members.member: The physics bodies this entity's simulation owns, as paths from the entity root. The core freezes them on a [constant MODE_PROXY] copy and restores the [member RigidBody3D.freeze] settings the scene authored when the copy runs again. Empty means the root, when it is a [RigidBody2D] or [RigidBody3D]. A value written after the entity goes live warns, and the bodies it had stay in effect.

When a body of this entity runs here as [constant MODE_AUTHORITY] and touches a free entity that also sets it, this peer claims that entity with [constant NetwEntity.HOLD_YIELDABLE]. A claimed entity claims what it touches in the same tick. A touch claims when it begins or while the touched body moves. A body that [member release_on_rest] gave back while it still touches stays free until it moves again. The session grants the claim only while this peer controls the entity that touched it, so a refused grab takes nothing it touched. Setting it turns on [member RigidBody3D.contact_monitor] for the bodies. It needs [constant NetwEntity.TRANSFER_IMMEDIATE] on an entity with no [method NetwPropertyConfig.state] row and no prediction, and does nothing otherwise.
The most ticks [constant RESTORE_EXTRAPOLATED] carries a sample forward.
The mode this entity runs in on this peer. [signal mode_changed] reports each change.

The seconds the bodies must sleep before this peer releases the entity with [method NetwEntity.release_authority]. It acts only while this peer is the confirmed controller with [constant NetwEntity.HOLD_YIELDABLE] and no body is frozen, so [constant NetwEntity.HOLD_EXCLUSIVE] never releases itself. A body that wakes before the session decides claims the entity again. [code]0[/code] turns it off. It needs [constant NetwEntity.TRANSFER_IMMEDIATE] on an entity with no [method NetwPropertyConfig.state] row and no prediction, and does nothing otherwise.
How the copies this peer does not author run. [constant REPLICAS_ACTIVE] makes every such copy [constant MODE_ACTIVE]. It can change at any time.

How a sample from the author lands on a [constant MODE_ACTIVE] copy. Under [constant NetwMultiplayer.LIVE_MODE_CHASE] the drawn position absorbs the jump up to [member NetwPredictionHandle.teleport_threshold], so the body snaps and the visual glides.
When [member step] runs and when the physics server moves the bodies.
The entities this entity selects on this peer right now.

The step the core calls in the phase [member schedule] names, while [member mode] runs the body. It is called as [code](delta: float, tick: int, is_fresh: bool)[/code]. It reads the root's [code]_network_tick[/code] when none is set. [code]is_fresh[/code] is true on a [constant MODE_AUTHORITY] or [constant MODE_PREDICT] step that moves the entity forward, and false in a replay and on every [constant MODE_ACTIVE] step. Gate input on it, so an active copy coasts on the samples it installs.

signal.name: mode_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [member mode] changes on this peer, after the body and the arriving samples have moved to [param mode].

constants.constant: Not simulated. The entity follows plain replication.
This peer authors the entity. The step runs and the samples go out from here.
This peer controls a predicted entity and runs it ahead of the server. See [NetwPredictionHandle].
A copy that runs forward and installs each sample it receives.
A frozen copy drawn from history, where it collides.
The step moves the entity once per tick.
The physics server moves the bodies in each frame that brings a tick, and the step runs once in that frame.

A [NetwPhysicsStepper] installed with [method NetwMultiplayer.predict_stepper_install] steps the space once per tick. An entity that does not declare prediction, or that stands in a space with no stepper, runs [constant SCHEDULE_FRAME] and reports one error.
[constant SCHEDULE_FRAME] when the entity has a physics body, and [constant SCHEDULE_TICK] otherwise.
Copies this peer does not author are [constant MODE_PROXY], unless a selection makes them active.
Copies this peer does not author are [constant MODE_ACTIVE].
A sample lands when it arrives, as it was authored.
A sample lands when it arrives, carried forward by its age along the property its interpolation projects by, for at most [member max_restore_ticks].
A sample is held until the clock's display tick reaches it, then lands as it was authored, so every sample lands at the same age.
